cohort: The study analyzed data from all live births in Japan recorded in national databases from April 2018 to October 2022.
finding: The overall proportion of Cesarean sections increased by 0.92% point during the COVID-19 pandemic in Japan.
mod_finding: The overall proportion of Cesarean sections increased by 0.92% point during the COVID-19 pandemic in Japan, reaching a peak in Wave 6 (22.14%).
